title: Homes
reading: There are between 2.7 and 3 million homes in Norway. Roughly half of them are detached houses. In big cities like Oslo, many housing units are in blocks of flats. In small municipalities, most homes are detached houses. Around 82 per cent of households own their own home, while the remaining 18 per cent rent their home.

Buying a home costs a lot of money, and most people borrow money from the bank. People usually pay back the loan every month for many years. We can’t borrow the entire purchase price from the bank. We also need to have some money ourselves. This is called own funds. The main rule is that we must have saved 10 per cent of the purchase price ourselves. We can then borrow 90 per cent of the purchase price from the bank. People must however have regular income or other financial security to be allowed to borrow money from the bank. The bank must be sure that people are able to pay instalments and interest.
discussion: Talk together Talk about the advantages and disadvantages of owning or renting your home. Talk about the differences between owner-occupied homes and homes in housing cooperatives. What do you think about borrowing money from the bank? What does it involve? You can go to finn.no or another website and look at the properties for sale in the area where you live. What kind of properties do you see? What do they cost? GettyImages GettyImages
exercises: Select the right answer How many homes are there in Norway? less than 2 million more than 2.5 million more than 3.5 million Select the right answer Which kind of home is characterised by having an exclusive right to use your home complying with rules and statutes paying a deposit when you buy an apartment paying rent every month owner-occupied dwelling housing cooperative rental property Select the right answer How much of the purchase price do we need to have saved ourselves when we are going to buy a home? How much can we borrow from the bank? We must have saved 10 per cent of the purchase price, and can borrow 90 per cent of the purchase price from the bank. We must have saved 50 per cent of the purchase price, and can borrow 50 per cent of the purchase price from the bank. We must have saved 90 per cent of the purchase price, and can borrow 10 per cent of the purchase price from the bank. Select the right answer What characterises an owner-occupied dwelling? You can do it up and rent it out without asking anyone. You own a share in a housing cooperative. You pay all the expenses in connection with your home yourself. You pay rent every month. You must comply with the housing cooperative’s rules and statutes. Select right or wrong Read the statements. What is right? What is wrong? Most people borrow money from a bank when they are going to buy a home. Right Wrong Around 82 per cent of households own their own home. Right Wrong 90 per cent of homes in Oslo are detached houses. Right Wrong Own funds is money we have saved ourselves. Right Wrong You need to have regular income or other financial security to be allowed to borrow money from a bank. Right Wrong

Nesten alle boliger har innlagt vann og strøm, og ofte er det flere bad i en bolig. Boligene varmes opp med elektrisk strøm, parafin, gass eller olje. Mange bruker ved i tillegg. Nordmenn synes det er koselig å fyre i peisen. De bruker også mye tid og penger på å gjøre det fint inne i, og rundt. boligene sine. Se filmen Videoen består av syv klipp som viser prosessen med å kjøpe en bolig for et ungt samboerpar. I første klipp ser vi paret snakke sammen mens de ser på en PC, før vi ser et budsjett og en kalkulator. Deretter begynner de å spare, og setter penger oppi et spareglass. I fjerde klipp går paret på visning, før de drar på et møte i banken. De to siste klippene viser at de får nøklene til sin nye bolig, og flytter tingene sine inn i stua. Forslag til spørsmål: Er det mange som eier boligen sin i ditt hjemland? Hvilke sparetips ville du gitt en venn som prøver å spare til bolig? Hva synes du det er viktig å tenke over når man kjøper bolig? Hvilke fordeler og ulemper er det ved å kjøpe seg bolig? Samtalestarter Datteren: Rommet mitt er så lite! Jeg får ikke plass til en sofa en gang! Moren: Du da! Du har jo i alle fall eget rom! Da jeg var liten, måtte jeg dele rom med lillesøsteren min. Bestemoren: Vi har det jo så godt nå. Da jeg var liten, bodde mor og far og alle vi seks barna i en liten leilighet. Jeg husker godt hvor kaldt det var å gå på utedoen i bakgården om vinteren.
